outcome: Give Tech teams a working AIOps — Incident Prediction & Root-Cause Copilot capability on their own data — it cuts incident MTTR and P1 frequency.
overview: Every minute of a severity-one outage costs revenue and service credits, yet engineers spend the first of them deciding which of thousands of alerts matter. This copilot ingests logs, metrics and traces into one time-series store, correlates related alerts into a single incident, learns the patterns that precede degradation, and narrates the probable root cause with the evidence behind it and a suggested remediation. It advises the on-call engineer: remediation stays a human decision and nothing self-heals. A five-to-six week build on real telemetry and past incident history shows how much of the noise is suppressible and whether time-to-diagnosis moves against this estate’s own baseline.
